metadata.no_hallucinations_commitment: Every seller address, phone number, support email, BBB accreditation status, BBB letter grade, return window, resizing/custom/engraving exclusion, and credit card payment policy was verified directly against official retailer policy pages and Better Business Bureau (bbb.org) business profiles on 2026-10-22. Any detail not explicitly published on the fetched official pages is left blank (null) and flagged as unverified.

sellers.physical_address: 590 5th Avenue (btwn. 47th & 48th St), New York, NY 10036 (Appointment Showroom); 88 10th Ave #10, New York, NY 10011 (BBB File)
sellers.return_clock_starts: Delivery date (must mail back within 14 days of label issuance to avoid recycling fee)
sellers.refund_form: Original payment method or Automic Gold gift card (free US prepaid return label for first return)
sellers.custom_resized_engraved_exclusions: Modified jewelry, custom designs, and engraved rings (+$60) are Final Sale and ineligible for return or exchange.
sellers.credit_card_details: All major credit & debit cards accepted directly (plus PayPal, Shop Pay, Affirm, AfterPay, Apple Pay, Google Pay)
sellers.xrf_inspection_guidance: 30-day delivery-based return window allows ample time for non-destructive 0.01g scale check and ISO 23345:2021 ED-XRF scan before removing tags or engraving. Never scratch/acid-test or resize prior to return approval.
irregularity_flags: BBB rating discrepancy on bbb.org: main profile page displays 'A+' while '/overview-of-bbb-ratings' subpage displays 'NR' (insufficient information).
Optional +$60 engraving immediately voids 30-day return rights.

sellers.physical_address: 650 S. Hill St., #728, Los Angeles, CA 90014 (LA Jewelry District — pickup showroom & returns)
sellers.return_clock_starts: Receipt date ('Orders which are over 30 days of receipt do not qualify for return policy')
sellers.refund_form: Credit back to original credit card charged within 7 business days (engraving & shipping non-refundable; buyer pays insured return shipping)
sellers.custom_resized_engraved_exclusions: Items showing wear, resized by a jeweler other than Sarraf Jewelry Inc., altered, special-ordered, custom nameplates, or engraved bangles/watches cannot be returned (engraved standard rings forfeit $25 engraving fee).
sellers.credit_card_details: Credit card payments explicitly verified (refunds credited to same credit card; alternate shipping address must be on file with credit card issuer); exact card network list not enumerated on static policy snippet

irregularity_flags: Customer service phone hours are limited to Monday–Thursday 10:00 AM–4:00 PM PST.
Older product-tab templates show conflicting post-30-day warranty repair shipping/handling fees ('$50 or 5%' on some pages vs '$100 or 10%' on others).
Return shipments must be insured by the buyer; non-insured packages are returned to sender.

sellers.physical_address: 375 Ghent Road, Akron, OH 44333 (Signet/Privacy Notice Address); 2855 Stevens Creek Blvd Ste 1105, Santa Clara, CA 95050 (BBB Profile)
sellers.return_clock_starts: SHIPMENT date ('within 30 days from the shipment date' — transit days reduce effective inspection window)
sellers.refund_form: Full refund to original payment method (up to 2 complimentary insured return labels per customer per year; RMA required on box exterior)
sellers.custom_resized_engraved_exclusions: Personalized jewelry, custom orders, engraved items, items resized after initial purchase, Diamond Upgrade purchases, clearance, and Final Sale items are NOT eligible for return or exchange. Comparison purchasing is prohibited.

sellers.walk_away_check_status: CONDITIONAL — Request Written Gram Weight & Karat Clarification Before Ordering
irregularity_flags: Return clock begins on SHIPMENT date rather than delivery date.
Resizing after initial purchase permanently voids return/exchange eligibility.
Omits gram weight across solitaire engagement setting pages and exhibited an 18K-vs-14K copy conflict on Stock 501290y.

sellers.physical_address: 307-334 Adelaide Street West, Toronto, Ontario M5V 1R4, Canada
sellers.return_clock_starts: Receipt date ('within seven (7) days of receipt'; must ship within 7 days of receiving return label)
sellers.refund_form: Self-service dashboard return issues Menē Credit (non-redeemable for cash & subject to expiry); original-payment-method refund requires contacting Customer Care and may incur UP TO 10% RESTOCKING FEE (plus 5% fee if Certificate of Authenticity is missing)
sellers.custom_resized_engraved_exclusions: Engraved, customized, or personalized Products are Final Sale. Cancelling an order >24 hours after placement or after shipment incurs up to 10% restocking fee.

sellers.walk_away_check_status: CAUTION — Strict 7-Day Window & Up to 10% Discretionary Cash-Refund Restocking Fee
irregularity_flags: STRICT 7-DAY RETURN & FEE WARNING (CHK-07 / CHK-12): Sep 2, 2026 Terms of Service allow Menē to deduct up to a 10% restocking fee on discretionary original-payment-method refunds, while self-service 7-day returns issue non-cash Menē Credit subject to expiry.
Missing Certificate of Authenticity triggers an additional 5% assessment deduction.
Pure 24K gold (99.99% Au) is physically softer than 14K/18K alloys for prong-set gemstone rings (Menē sells plain 24K bands/rings without prong-set gemstones).
